name: waypoint-api-contracts
description: waypoint-api-contracts tooling: 10 wp-contracts-* agents (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, shared enumeration, code generation, documentation and release builders plus read-only breaking-change, consistency and consumer-impact reviewers, plus a .github maintainer), 11 /wp-* commands, 7 path-scoped rules, 8 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a waypoint-api-contracts checkout.
